description:
The animation is based on the popular picture book series "You Look So Yummy" (おまえうまそうだな, Omae Umaso da na) by Japanese author Tatsuya Miyanishi, featuring dinosaurs. It`s a heartwarming and healing story about family, friendship, courage, and love among dinosaurs. In the distant Cretaceous period, many different kinds of dinosaurs with distinct personalities lived. The protagonist, Ricky the Tyrannosaurus Rex, is fierce on the outside but gentle on the inside. With a kind heart, he always tries his best to help his friends overcome various crises. Year after year, Rachel and his friends understand and support each other, living happily in the dinosaur world and slowly growing up…
